answers.LO_CORE_01_BUSINESS_SCOPE:
I am an individual originator at a retail mortgage lender. I do not own the company or manage the processing and underwriting staff. Shared staff are assigned through the company.

I have no direct reports or team member MORE Profile IDs. The processors and underwriters are shared colleagues. I have not done a time study or worked out a cost case for more support.
answers.LO_CORE_02_PRIMARY_GOAL:
I want to go from 24 funded loans to 36 over the next twelve months. At the same average loan size that would be $12.6M. I have not filled out a detailed 1-3-5 plan yet.

I want 36 funded loans with good service and a week I can sustain. Tuesday and Thursday from three-thirty are family and pickup time; other mornings and some early evenings can work. In two years I would like less variation in the business and in how late I am working. In three years I would like to be sharing more of what I know with colleagues. In five to seven years I want a steady practice and time for my family. I have not attached a production number to every one of those stages.
answers.LO_CORE_03_PRODUCTION_WINDOWS: From September 1, 2025 through August 31, 2026, I funded 24 loans totaling $8,400,000, averaging $350,000. There were 20 purchase loans and 4 refinances. That is my production, not the lender's total. I have not pulled my compensation and expense records together for this. I do not have a useful breakdown of the cost of shared support either.
answers.LO_CORE_04_PURPOSE_APPLICABILITY: From September 1, 2025 through August 31, 2026, I funded 24 loans totaling $8,400,000, averaging $350,000. There were 20 purchase loans and 4 refinances. That is my production, not the lender's total. I have not pulled my compensation and expense records together for this. I do not have a useful breakdown of the cost of shared support either.
answers.LO_CORE_05_OPPORTUNITY_SOURCE_NETWORK:
Business comes from professional relationships, past customers and direct inquiries. I have not matched every funded loan back to a partner, so I cannot give you a dependable partner contribution report. The contact export has 300 rows, including older inquiries that need review. I have not counted which of those are real working relationships. I also have not lined up applications and fundings with the reasons files stopped along the way.

I would follow up with a professional I know about something they asked me, then contact a past customer. I like a useful one-to-one conversation. I have a partner presentation I have put off while working on the slides, which is frustrating because I know the subject. I would need to use material the company allows. I would try to get meetings on the calendar, though I would not know how many I could arrange today.

answers.LO_CORE_08_RELATIONSHIP_SYSTEMS:
Active files live in the loan origination system. I use the company CRM, a calendar and checklists for conversations and handoffs. I coordinate with processing and underwriting. I do not have good cycle-time or follow-up completion figures to give you. I have not included our company rules or approved materials in this intake.

My manager reviews active work, but partner development does not get the same regular attention. My partner and I compare our family schedule on Sunday. File preparation and checklists are dependable for me; reaching out is easier to move to next week. I tried a revised customer explanation after my manager approved it and kept some of the changes. I have not settled on a regular outside accountability arrangement.
